 )\n            normalized_path = _normalized_key(path)\n            product_read = host == SOURCE_HOST and (\n                path == APPROVED_PRODUCT_DETAIL_PATH\n                or any(key in normalized_path for key in _SOURCE_PRODUCT_ID_KEYS)\n            )\n            terminal_auth_submit = (\n                method == \"POST\"\n                and exact_xauth\n                and resource_type == \"document\"\n                and is_navigation\n                and top_frame\n                and shape_ok\n                and redirects_ok\n                and not _XAUTH_FORBIDDEN_WRITE_PATH.search(path)\n            )\n\n            if method in ALLOWED_READ_METHODS and not product_read and safe_url:\n                classification = \"safe_read\"\n            elif terminal_auth_submit:\n                classification = (\n                    \"late_auth_submit\" if self._terminal_capture_sealed else \"auth_submit\"\n                )\n            elif (\n                method == \"POST\"\n                and exact_xauth\n                and not _XAUTH_FORBIDDEN_WRITE_PATH.search(path)\n            ):\n                classification = \"xauth_security_post\"\n            elif product_read:\n                classification = \"forbidden_product_read\"\n            elif method not in ALLOWED_READ_METHODS:\n                classification = \"forbidden_mutation\"\n            else:\n                classification = \"invalid_read\"\n\n            observation = _AuthContractObservation(\n                method=method,\n top_frame=top_frame,\n                redirect_count=redirect_count,\n                classification=classification,\n                phase=self._phase,\n            )\n            key = self._remember(observation)\n\n            if method in ALLOWED_READ_METHODS and not product_read and safe_url:\n                route.continue_()\n                return\n\n            route.abort(\"blockedbyclient\")\n            if terminal_auth_submit:\n                if not self._terminal_capture_sealed:\n                    self._auth_submit_key = key\n                return\n            if classification == \"xauth_security_post\" and shape_ok and redirects_ok:\n                return\n            self._poison_once(\n                \"auth discovery observed an unsafe product read or mutation\",\n                classification=classification,\n            )\n        except BaseException as exc:\n            # Callback failures are reduced to type-only poison.  Never include a\n            # request value or exception message that might contain credentials.\n            self._poison_once(\n                \"auth discovery callback could not prove a except BaseException:\n                pass\n\n    def _handle_web_socket(self, route: Any) -> None:\n        self._callback_count += 1\n        try:\n            scheme, host, path, safe_url = self._safe_url_parts(_member(route, \"url\"))\n            trusted_origin = safe_url and host in {SOURCE_HOST, LOGIN_HOST}\n            classification = (\n                \"blocked_auth_socket\" if trusted_origin else \"forbidden_socket\"\n            )\n            self._remember(\n                _AuthContractObservation(\n                    method=\"WEBSOCKET\",\n                    scheme=scheme,\n                    host=host,\n                    path=path,\n                    resource_type=\"websocket\",\n                    is_navigation=False,\n                    top_frame=False,\n                    redirect_count=0,\n                    classification=classification,\n                    phase=self._phase,\n                )\n            )\n            route.close(code=1008, reason=\"credential-blind auth discovery\")\n            if not trusted_origin:\n                self._poison_once(\n                    \"auth discovery observed a socket outside the exact WING origins\",\n                    classification=classification,\n                )\n        except BaseException as exc:\n            self._poison_once(\n                \"auth discovery WebSocket callback could not close safely\",\n                classification=f\"callback_error:{type(exc).__name__}\",\n            )\n            try:\n                route.close(code=1008, reason=\"credential-blind auth discovery\")\n            except BaseException:\n                pass\n\n    def assert_clean(self) -> None:\n        if self._poison is not \"auth discovery navigation URL is invalid\"\n            ) from exc\n        if not valid_origin:\n            raise AccountOrAuthBlocked(\n                \"auth discovery navigation left the exact return self.artifact_path\n\n\ndef _launch_dedicated_profile_context(manager: Any, profile: Path) -> Any:\n    \"\"\"Launch the one dedicated profile and require its inert default page.\"\"\"\n\n
